method: Every flagged (patient, trial) pair read by hand against the trial's inclusion text on 2026-11-27. A pair is false when the patient as stated would meet the trial's biomarker criteria.

false_positives.why: ER-negative, any PR, any HER2; 'triple positive ... not eligible' read as a requirement
'ER/PR positive cells ratio <10%, or HER2 positive' admits ER/PR-low or HER2+
'hormonal therapy in cases with HR+ tumor' is a treatment rule, not a requirement
primary HER2+ tumour required; an extra ER+ lesion is allowed, not required
uncertain: receptor clause is a disjunction and the HER2 clause context is truncated; counted false
